notes.title: 【E.T.E】Bug Fix Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

The issue regarding the "noise from the basic attack key" bug has been fixed as a priority. Please restart the game to continue your journey smoothly.

If you encounter any other problems or have suggestions, feel free to contact us.

Customer Support Email: AITAsteam2025@gmail.com

notes.title: First release on 4.15, win limited edition skins and steam recharge cards!
notes.notes:
Highly anticipated! [E.T.E] is about to be launched on Steam! Combining plot, graphics, combat system, exploration content and emotional resonance, whether you are an old player or a new player, you can find your own fun in this two-dimensional mecha-style game. Now join this fantasy world together!
In order to welcome the official launch of the game, we will randomly select players who registered on the first day to give away gifts such as "limited game skins" and "steam 100 yuan recharge cards"!
[previewyoutube=9Ckf-WldfCk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]【Event Prizes】[/b]
1. "Limited Edition Game Character Skin" x 3
2. "Starting 188 Travel Fees" x 100
3. "Steam Recharge Card 100 Yuan" x 10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470433/e0ad94c84a59f8aa6ff9c19d9144c35ded50d2d0.png[/img]
[b]【Participation Method】[/b]
Register your character on the game's first release day (UTC+8, April 15) to participate in the lucky draw!

[b]【Prize Collection】[/b]
The winning players will be selected within 3 working days after the event ends (UTC+8 on April 18), and the results will be announced in the Steam community announcement, QQ group and Discord group. Winning users can contact the game customer service through the community, email, etc. on the game store page to claim the rewards. If the winning results are not claimed within 7 working days after the announcement, it will be deemed as a waiver.

[b]【Event time】[/b]
Ends at 24:00UTC+8 on April 15
